author: Kirutheeka7
body:
#### PR description:

* While investigating the UBSAN build errors reported in [cms-sw/cmssw#50665](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/50665) and [cms-sw/cmssw#50890 (comment)](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/issues/50890#issuecomment-4386036058), it was seen that the `FastTrackerRecHitMatcher` algorithm is specific to phase-0/phase-1 strip trackers, which had stereo modules. Since these modules are no longer a part of phase-2 strip trackers, the algorithm can be removed from the workflow fixing the issues.
* Fixed another build error with respect to casting of PixelTopology in `PixelTemplateSmearerBase.cc`
* Updated strip resolution parameters as obtained from: [Phase-2 tracker page for OTv800, ITv702](https://cms-tklayout.web.cern.ch/reference/OT800_IT702/index.html)
* Updated material thickness parameters as obtained from the same page.

#### PR validation:

Ran workflow 36434.0 successfully.
